subject: Engagement models & renewal approach for SOC 2 / ISO audits
messages:
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@prism-partners.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: SOC 2 & ISO Engagement Models — Prism Partners

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks for the invite to respond. Attached is a concise scope and three engagement models we typically offer for mid‑market SaaS customers:

1) Annual fixed engagement (start-to-finish SOC 2 Type II or ISO cycle) — single fee covering evidence collection, fieldwork, and reporting; priority scheduling window.
2) Retainer + hourly (managed remediation + audit execution) — lower up-front; retainer covers ongoing advisory and a block of fieldwork hours.
3) Multi-year subscription (3-year commitment) — discounted pricing, guaranteed rotation planning and annual health checks; recommended if you want predictability and prefer a single partner for continuity.

High-level cost ranges (ballpark):
- Fixed: $65k – $95k per cycle
- Retainer: $30k/yr + hourly (day rates apply)
- Subscription (3 yrs): $50k/yr equivalent (paid annually) with a ~10–15% discount vs single-cycle pricing

SLA / windows: we can guarantee audit slots for commitments signed by June 15th; otherwise next available window is Q4.

Attaching: Prism_Partners_Scope_2028.pdf (scope and sample SOW).

Questions for you to help us narrow options:
- Are you expecting to bundle SOC 2 and ISO (one combined engagement) or run them as separate cycles?
- Do you have a procurement preferred billing model (CapEx vs. OpEx)?
- Any constraints on audit window (e.g., calendar year close or external regulators)?

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if useful — propose Wednesday 10–11am PT.

Best,
Evan Cho
Engagement Lead, Prism Partners
E: evan.cho@prism-partners.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@prism-partners.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SOC 2 & ISO Engagement Models — Prism Partners

Evan — thanks for this. Quick answers and a few clarifying asks (so we can compare apples-to-apples):

- We plan to run SOC 2 Type II for our core platform and pursue ISO 27001 as a parallel but technically separate engagement (same documentation where possible, separate certification).
- Finance prefers CapEx booking for this spend but we can be flexible if there are savings with an OpEx model.
- Audit window constraint: we need reporting completed before our enterprise renewal cycle in November (so fieldwork ideally Sept–Oct).

Clarifying asks:
- Can you provide a sample timeline for a combined approach vs. separate flows? (we want to see where overlap saves time/cost)
- Please include reference clients (two similar‑size SaaS orgs) and one sample redacted report.
- What does your ‘subscription’ plan include for remediation support (hours / SLAs)?

Attaching our RFP spreadsheet: RI_Soc2_RFP_2028.xlsx — it has required evidence bundles and a preferred contract template. If you can redline w/ your SOW and upload to DocuSign, that would accelerate procurement.

We can do Wed 10:30am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SOC 2 & ISO Engagement Models — Prism Partners

Agree with Hannah’s constraints. Two additional procurement items from my side:

- Please include a 3-year TCO comparison showing line items (audit fees, remediation advisory, travel, any 3rd-party tooling). I attached a quick calc: engagement_model_tco_calc.xlsx.
- We should evaluate a rotation strategy: rotating assurance partner every 3 years reduces concentration risk and can drive better pricing/quality. Please provide a short note on how Prism would support transition planning if we did a rotation at year 3.
- Legal will want standard indemnities and an SLA for report delivery; include proposed contract clauses you expect to see.

I’m flexible on the billing model as long as total committed $ over 3 years is within forecast.

—Markus
VP, Finance & Procurement | Redwood Inference

Hannah / Markus — appreciate the quick responses. Attached are two items: a combined SOC2+ISO timeline & a draft SOW redline (I removed sensitive pricing on the shared PDF but included the numbers in the redlined SOW).

Key updates:
- We can target fieldwork in mid-September if contract is signed by June 15th.
- Subscription model includes quarterly health checks, a 24/7 advisory hotline (priority queue), and up to 40 hours/yr of remediation advisory; additional hours billed at standard day-rate.
- Transition plan: we provide a transferrable documentation package, a 30-day overlap window for knowledge transfer, and exportable evidence bundles to ease rotation. We’ll include explicit handoff milestones in the SOW.

Pricing snapshot (for commercial eval):
- Combined fixed engagement (SOC2 + ISO): $120,000 (one-time)
- 3-year subscription: $48,000/yr (total $144,000) with the services described above
- Retainer model: $35,000/yr + hourly for fieldwork (range depends on hours used)

DocuSign link for the draft SOW: https://docusign.com/rooms/abcd1234
Drive folder with sample reports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f

Cc’ing Alyssa from ProcureWise — Alyssa, appreciate any feedback on procurement preferences (billing cadence, PO requirements, insurance clauses) and if you can run our standard commercial comparison template against these numbers.

Thanks — I’ll join the Wed 10:30am slot if confirmed.

Best,
Evan
